name: ZED joining reward and certification subsidy
benefit_text: Rs 10,000 joining reward after the ZED pledge. It covers the Bronze fee of Rs 10,000, so Bronze is effectively free. Silver costs Rs 40,000 and Gold Rs 90,000, with a subsidy of 80% (micro), 60% (small) or 50% (medium) of the fee.

otherwise.reason: Open to any MSME with Udyam registration

zed.women_owned_line: 100% subsidy on the cost of ZED certification for women-owned MSMEs (from 11 Nov 2023, PIB 4 Aug 2026)
zed.reward_note: Once only; valid 1 year after the pledge. For Silver or Gold the reward is deducted first, then the subsidy applies.
zed.bank_note: Published by each bank on the ZED portal, with no date. Re-check with the bank before relying on it. Bank of Baroda's rate concession applies only if the rate stays at or above BRLLR / MCLR+SP.

quoted_line: if an MSME uses the reward for applying for Bronze Certification, the effective cost to MSME becomes zero

name: SIDBI 4E (End to End Energy Efficiency)
benefit_text: Loan up to Rs 15 crore for energy-efficiency projects. Rate is MCLR linked (SIDBI publishes no number). Repayment up to 84 months including up to 12 months moratorium. The project must show energy-efficiency or GHG reduction.

when.reason: needs at least 3 years of operations

otherwise.reason: 3+ years of operations and cash profits

quoted_line: MSMEs having minimum 3 years of operations and cash profits.
status_note: An older SIDBI document gives different terms; the live page is used.

name: MSE-GIFT interest subvention (RAMP)
benefit_text: 2% a year interest subvention for up to 5 years on term loans up to Rs 2 crore. Apply through a participating lender.

when.reason: for micro and small units only

otherwise.reason: The machine must be on the scheme's list of 890 technologies; ask the lender

quoted_line: offering a 2% interest subvention per annum for a maximum of 5 years on term loans up to INR 2 crores

name: SIDBI Green Finance Scheme
benefit_text: Loan up to Rs 50 crore, at most 75% of the project cost. MCLR linked. Repayment up to 10 years including up to 18 months moratorium.

otherwise.reason: Terms depend on the project; ask SIDBI or your lender

quoted_line: Financing upto Rs. 50 crore subject to maximum of 75% of the total project cost.

name: ADEETIE (BEE) interest subvention
benefit_text: 5% interest subvention for micro and small units, 3% for medium, FY 2025-26 to 2027-28. The project must show 10% energy savings.

when.reason: Foundry is a covered sector, but the Hyderabad cluster is not confirmed

otherwise.reason: Covered sector list not checked for your sector

quoted_line: 5% interest subvention for Micro and Small Enterprises
status_note: Hyderabad cluster inclusion not found in the sources opened.

name: Telangana Cleaner Production Subsidy (MSME Policy 2024)
benefit_text: 25% subsidy on specific cleaner production measures, up to Rs 5 lakh. Claim within 6 months of commercial production.

when.reason: for new units or expansions only
for new units or expansions only

otherwise.reason: GHMC area is excluded except industrial estates; check your location

source: Telangana MSME Policy 2024 operational guidelines, s2.1.11 p.8 and s4.9 p.20
quoted_line: Cleaner Production Subsidy : 25% subsidy on Specific Cleaner Production Measures limited to Rs.5.00 Lakhs.

name: Telangana ZED and quality reimbursement (MSME Policy 2024)
benefit_text: 50% of the certification cost, up to Rs 2 lakh (SC/ST/PwD: 100%, up to Rs 3 lakh). The cap counts money from all sources, including central ZED help.

when.reason: for new units or expansions only
for new units or expansions only

otherwise.reason: GHMC area is excluded except industrial estates; Sanathnagar, Azamabad, Chandulal Baradari and Kattedan estates are fully excluded

source: Telangana MSME Policy 2024 operational guidelines, s4.8 p.19 and s1.2 p.6
quoted_line: the total subsidy from all sources is limited to Rs.2.00 Lakhs/certificate.
